title: Build the Exhaust
description: Route a simplified exhaust path through a tight vehicle envelope while minimizing restriction, length, and turbulent losses.
hints: Tight direction changes can create a large wake and extra loss.
A smooth transition can outperform a shorter but sharper route.

showcase.fidelity_note: MVP uses simplified 2D incompressible flow. It does not model exhaust pulses, compressibility, acoustics, scavenging, temperature, RPM, catalyst behavior, or dyno-grade power effects.
